rows.name: I am sorry
rows.descriptionMd: When you are apologising, quiet beats grand and early beats late. Pale roses, white tulips and freesias are the right register, and the card matters more than the flowers — write it yourself and we will have it written out by hand. Next working day in most cities we cover. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoDescription: Pale roses, white tulips and freesias with a card written out by hand. Quiet rather than grand, next working day in most cities.
